title: Figure. The Golden Rule
caption: Steady-state consumption per worker c*(s) as a function of the saving rate s. Hill-shaped: too little saving and you produce too little; too much saving and you never consume. The maximum sits at s** = α (marked). At low s, ↑s helps consumption; past the peak, the trade-off reverses.

curves.name: c*(s)
curves.expr: (1 - k) * Math.pow(B, 1 / (1 - alpha)) * Math.pow(k / (n + delta), alpha / (1 - alpha))
